title: J4 follow-up: audio emulation held while the in-game editor is on screen

facts.title: mcpx_apu_hold parks the whole APU while the hidden game idles behind its live editor (55% -> ~6% of a core)
facts.fact: apu_core.c mcpx_apu_hold(1) makes mcpx_apu_frame_thread wait on its condition at the top of its loop, between frames (never inside the guest ISR or an output wait), so the voice processor, the GP/EP DSP frames (dsp_thread_main only runs when the frame thread hands it one), the doorbell ack, the output and interrupt delivery all stop with nothing reset; mcpx_apu_hold(0) wakes it under the APU lock. It is separate from the title's pause_requested. Measured: hidden game 47-63% of a core before, 5.2-6.7% after; the remainder is nv2a_ack_thread (~1.7%), kernel_timer_thread (~1.6%, 1 ms timer), ohci_thread (~1.3%), fb_thread, XAudio2, clock_worker and the game's one menu frame a second, none of it audio.
facts.how_to_use: Commit e04f328 on v35-edgame (exe f84e9098). Log: [APU] audio emulation held / running again and [SCN-LIVE] audio emulation held / running. Getting under 5% would also need the nv2a ack (250 us poll), the kernel timer (1 ms) and the USB thread to idle (other files).
